component.name: virt-meow
component.summary: Manage libvirt virtual machines, here or over SSH
管理本机或远程 (SSH) 的 libvirt 虚拟机

description.p: virt-meow is a libvirt virtual machine manager, a modern replacement for virt-manager: for the machines on this computer, or on others over SSH.

ul.li: Several connections at once (qemu:///system, qemu:///session, qemu+ssh), kept alive and reconnected on their own
SSH in process, with host keys checked and trusted only on your word
Create machines from an ISO, with BIOS, UEFI or Secure Boot and a TPM
Disks, networks, storage pools, snapshots and the XML definition
VNC and SPICE consoles, and the serial console
The same from the command line, virt-mm, and in a browser with virt-mm serve

description.p: This is an alpha release: it is tested against libvirt in a container, little yet on real hosts.
This package ships the official release build unmodified. The command line is available as flatpak run --command=virt-mm io.github.jing2uo.VirtMeow help.

Permissions: network, the GPU, this computer's libvirt sockets (/run/libvirt and the session daemon's), the SSH agent and ~/.ssh read-only for keys and known hosts, notifications and the keychain. Storage stays with libvirt: an ISO or disk image is uploaded into a storage pool from the file dialog, so no folder of yours is shared.
